{{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} | Overworld model from {{color2|000|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |}{{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Chalmers Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Chalmers as a {{tc|Team Flare Admin}} in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== In [[Pokémon Adventures]], Chalmers is an active {{tc|Team Flare Admin}}. In ''[[PS568|Connecting with Gardevoir]]'', he attacked [[Gurkinn]] in order to obtain the secrets of [[Mega Evolution]] for his superiors. Although Chalmers defeated Gurkinn, he was soon defeated by [[Diantha]], one of Gurkinn's students, and forced to run away. Later, Chalmers was seen locking {{kal|Grace}} back into her cell at the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]] after her fifth attempt to escape had ended in a failure. Later, Chalmers and a female Admin, along with [[Malva's Delphox]], were seen overseeing the plan to tie the Pokémon captured from the [[Pokémon Village]] to the prototype Absorbers on {{rt|10|Kalos}} so that their [[Death in the Pokémon world#Life-force|life energy]] could be drained to re-fuel the [[ultimate weapon]]. The plan was interrupted by the arrival of [[Alexa]], [[Viola]], [[Clemont]], [[Bonnie]], and [[Yvette]]. All Team Flare members on the route were defeated, thus putting a stop to their plan. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Chalmers |pkmn=Skrelp (multiple) |type1=Poison |type2=Water |img=Chalmers Skrelp Adventures.png |cap=Chalmers's Skrelp |epnum=PS568 |epname=Connecting with Gardevoir |desc=Chalmers has multiple {{p|Skrelp}}, which he used against Gurkinn, poisoning him.
